lines.text: Very much goes at the end
Many learners say: I like very much pizza.
Better: I like pizza very much.
Put very much after the object.
Music very much! I like music very much.

data.why: Put very much after the object.

native.tip: En inglés “very much” va al final, no entre el verbo y el objeto.
native.caption: En español “me gusta mucho la pizza”, pero el orden en inglés cambia 🍕 No “I like very much pizza.”, sino “I like pizza very much.”. ¡Escucha a Ama y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.

en.tip: In English “very much” goes at the end, not between the verb and the object.
